data.content:
Build succeeds. Here's what was created:

**Architecture: Blazor Web App with Auto render mode**
- **First visit** → Server-side rendered (fast load, no WASM download wait)
- **Subsequent interaction** → WebAssembly takes over (no server round-trips, snappy for worldwide users)
- **Auth** → ASP.NET Identity with Individual accounts, role claims serialized to WASM

**Project structure:**

| Component | Location |
|---|---|
| Shared models & DTOs | `ShipmentTracker.Client/Models/` |
| Client service (HTTP) | `ShipmentTracker.Client/Services/ShipmentHttpService.cs` |
| Server service (DB, prerender) | `ShipmentTracker/Services/ShipmentServerService.cs` |
| REST API endpoints | `ShipmentTracker/Endpoints/ShipmentEndpoints.cs` |
| Dispatcher dashboard | `ShipmentTracker.Client/Pages/Dispatcher.razor` |
| Customer "My Shipments" | `ShipmentTracker.Client/Pages/MyShipments.razor` |
| Public tracking page | `ShipmentTracker.Client/Pages/TrackShipment.razor` |
| DB entity + seed data | `ShipmentTracker/Data/` + `Services/DataSeeder.cs` |

**Demo accounts** (seeded automatically):
- **Dispatcher:** `dispatcher@shiptrack.com` / `Dispatch1!`
- **Customer:** `customer@example.com` / `Customer1!`

Run with `dotnet run --project ShipmentTracker`.
